name: Jenkins - Overview
description: The Jenkins - Overview dashboard provides relation between job and Executors on a Jenkins master. Dashboard helps you to relate job run duration, status, physical memory, disk memory, unused machine.
title: Jenkins - Overview

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"eventSource\":\"Shutdown\"" 
| _sourceHost as Master
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| count as Count by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}}) with 0 for Count
| outlier Count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Queue_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobName" as Name
| first(_raw) by Name, Master
| json field = _first "queueId", "queueTime", "isBlocked", "reasonForBlock", "isConcurrentBuild", "jobName", "jobURL" as %"Queue Id", %"Queue Time(sec)", Blocked, Reason, %"Concurrent Build", Name, URL nodrop
| tourl(URL, Name) as Name
| replace (URL, /\/[0-9]{1,}/, "") as URL
| where ![subquery : _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"logType\":\"Job_Status\""
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "jobBuildURL" as URL
| replace (URL, /\/[0-9]{1,}/, "") as URL
| count by URL, Master
| compose URL, Master]
| count by Master, %"Queue Time(sec)", Name, Blocked, Reason
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Jenkins_Log
| json "threadId", "logType", "logLevel", "logMessage", "logSource", "eventTime", "logStackTrace" as %"Thread ID", %"Log Type", %"Log Level", %"Log Message", %"Log Source", %"Event Time", %"Log Stack Trace" nodrop
| where %"Log Level" matches "{{LogLevel}}" AND %"Log Message" matches "{{LogMessage}}"
| where %"Log Message" matches "*WARN*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Warn*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*warn*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*FAIL*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*fail*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*EXCEPTION*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Exception*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*exception*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*ERROR*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*Error*" OR %"Log Message" matches "*error*"
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| count as Errors by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status
| json "name", "result", "jobRunDuration", "number" as JobName, Result, Duration, BuildNumber
| where JobName matches "{{JobName}}" and BuildNumber matches "{{BuildNumber}}"
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| Duration/60 as Duration
| avg(Duration) as Average, max(Duration) as Maximum, min(Duration) as Minimum by _timeslice 
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})
| fields - Maximum, Minimum, Maximum_1d, Minimum_1d

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Queue_Event
| json "queueId", "queueTime", "isBlocked", "reasonForBlock", "isConcurrentBuild", "jobName", "jobURL" as %"Queue Id", %"Queue Time(sec)", Blocked, Reason, %"Concurrent Build", Name, URL nodrop
| where URL matches "{{JobName}}"
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| First(%"Queue Time(sec)") as %"Queue Time(sec)" by %"Queue Id", _timeslice
| %"Queue Time(sec)"/60 as QueueTime
| avg(QueueTime) as Average, max(QueueTime) as Maximum, min(QueueTime) as Minimum by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})
| fields - Maximum, Minimum, Maximum_1d, Minimum_1d

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status
| json "name", "result", "number" as JobName, Result, BuildNumber
| where JobName matches "{{JobName}}" and BuildNumber matches "{{BuildNumber}}"
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", 1, 0) as Success
| if(Result matches "SUCCESS", 0, 1) as Failure
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| count as Total, sum(Success) as Success, sum(Failure) as Failure by _timeslice 
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})
| fields - Success, Failure, Success_1d, Failure_1d

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| json "numberOfExecutors", "nodeName", "nodeLabel", "numberOfFreeExecutors", "eventTime" as Total_Executors, NodeName, NodeLabel, Free_Executors, Event_Time nodrop
| where [subquery from=(-2d): _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* (*running on* OR *building on*)
| where _sourceName matches "{{JobName}}#{{BuildNumber}}"
| parse regex "Running on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| parse regex "Building on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| if (NodeName matches "Jenkins", "master", NodeName) as NodeName
| compose NodeName]
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}"
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| Total_Executors - Free_Executors as Busy_Executors
| first(Total_Executors) as Total_Executors, first(Busy_Executors) as Busy_Executors by NodeName, _timeslice
| where Busy_Executors >= 0
| sum(Total_Executors) as Total, sum(Busy_Executors) as Busy by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| json "numberOfExecutors", "nodeName", "nodeLabel", "numberOfFreeExecutors", "eventTime" as Total_Executors, NodeName, NodeLabel, Free_Executors, Event_Time nodrop
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}"
| where Total_Executors > 0
| where [subquery from=(-2d): _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* (*running on* OR *building on*)
| where _sourceName matches "{{JobName}}#{{BuildNumber}}"
| parse regex "Running on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| parse regex "Building on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| if (NodeName matches "Jenkins", "master", NodeName) as NodeName
| compose NodeName]
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| count_distinct (NodeName) as Total by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "isOnline", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount, Onilne, NodeLabel nodrop
| where ExecutorsCount > 0 AND Onilne matches "true"
| where [subquery from=(-2d): _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* (*running on* OR *building on*)
| where _sourceName matches "{{JobName}}#{{BuildNumber}}"
| parse regex "Running on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| parse regex "Building on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| if (NodeName matches "Jenkins", "master", NodeName) as NodeName
| compose NodeName]
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}"
| json field=_raw "monitorData.DiskSpaceMonitor" as Disk_Space nodrop
| parse regex field=Disk_Space "(?<Disk_Space>.*?) (?<Unit>.*[A-Z]+)" nodrop
| where !isEmpty(Disk_Space)
| num(Disk_Space)
| if(Unit in ("MB", "Mb", "mb"), Disk_Space/1024, if(Unit in ("KB", "Kb", "kb"), Disk_Space/1024/1024, if(Unit in ("TB", "Tb", "tb"), Disk_Space*1024, Disk_Space))) as Disk_Space
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| avg(Disk_Space) as Average, max(Disk_Space) as Maximum, min(Disk_Space) as Minimum by _timeslice
| fields _timeslice, Average, Minimum, Maximum
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})
| fields - Maximum, Minimum, Minimum_1d, Maximum_1d

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "isOnline", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount, Onilne, NodeLabel nodrop
| where ExecutorsCount > 0 AND Onilne matches "true"
| where [subquery from=(-2d): _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* (*running on* OR *building on*)
| where _sourceName matches "{{JobName}}#{{BuildNumber}}"
| parse regex "Running on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| parse regex "Building on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| if (NodeName matches "Jenkins", "master", NodeName) as NodeName
| compose NodeName]
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}"
| json "monitorData.SwapSpaceMonitor", "nodeLabel"  as SwapMemory, Node_Label nodrop
| parse field=SwapMemory "Memory:*  Swap:*" as Physical_Memory, Swap_Memory
| parse regex field=Physical_Memory "(?<Free_Memory>.*?)/(?<Total_Memory>.*?)[A-Z]"
| (Free_Memory/Total_Memory)*100 as Free_Memory
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| avg(Free_Memory) as Average, max(Free_Memory) as Maximum, min(Free_Memory) as Minimum by _timeslice
| fields _timeslice, Average, Minimum, Maximum
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})
| fields - Minimum, Maximum, Minimum_1d, Maximum_1d

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| json "numberOfExecutors", "nodeName", "nodeLabel", "numberOfFreeExecutors", "eventTime" as Total_Executors, NodeName, NodeLabel, Free_Executors, Event_Time nodrop
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}"
| where Total_Executors > 0
| where ![subquery from=(-2d): _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* (*running on* OR *building on*)
| where _sourceName matches "{{JobName}}#{{BuildNumber}}"
| parse regex "Running on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| parse regex "Building on (?<NodeName>.*) in" nodrop
| if (NodeName matches "Jenkins", "master", NodeName) as NodeName
| compose NodeName]
| timeslice {{TimeSlice}}
| count_distinct (NodeName) as Total by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift {{TimeCompare}}
| fillmissing timeslice({{TimeSlice}})

panels.title: Instructions
panels.text:
Dashboard can be used to get the co-relation between Jobs and Executors(Slaves).

* By Default, Dashboard shows all Jobs and Executors(Slaves) on a Jenkins Master.

* Use Filter, JobName ( with BuildNumber for specifics) to get Executors, machines attached, Console Logs error to a specific Job.
